CHAPTER 201

Section 201:1

201:1 Definitions.

In this chapter, "library" means any library operated by a city or town.

Source. 1971, 224:1, eff. Aug. 22, 1971.

Section 201:2

201:2 Library Directors.

The governing body of each city or town shall appoint a library director.

Source. 1971, 224:1. 1981, 456:3, eff. June 23, 1981.
